jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 24b (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/build-progress.mjs, tools/context-check.mjs, tools/dep-install.mjs, tools/history.mjs, tools/lessons-publish.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/build-progress.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/build-progress.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 49 `} catch { /* no tickets.log */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (tickets.log not created yet), log the rest (e.g. a parse error partway through reading the log); no fallback value, `doneLast7Days` keeps its running count.
- Line 325 `} catch { /* an incomplete or damaged run is not progress evidence */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (run folder removed mid-read, or torn state.json), log the rest; no fallback value, the run is simply omitted from `out`.

### tools/context-check.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/context-check.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 339 `} catch { /* a concurrently removed file is absent for this advisory check */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (test file deleted mid-scan), log the rest; no fallback value, loop continues to the next candidate file.
- Line 373 `} catch { /* does not exist yet */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (fs.statSync probing whether an output file already exists), log the rest; no fallback value, falls through to treat the output as new.

### tools/dep-install.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/dep-install.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 43 `const bytes = await fs.readFile(path.join(tmp, file)).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (expected file missing from the scratch install), log the rest; keep null fallback (handled via `if (!bytes ...) continue`).
- Line 49 `} finally { await fs.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {}); }`: cleanup with `{ recursive: true, force: true }` on fs.rm (can't ENOENT) — LOG-ALWAYS, include the tmp path; no fallback value, best-effort cleanup.

### tools/history.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/history.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 15 `const serial = fn => { const run = queue.then(fn, fn); queue = run.catch(() => {}); return run; };`: LEAVE — promise-queue serializer; the real rejection still reaches the caller through the returned `run` promise.
- Line 67 `try { const handle = await fs.open(file, 'r'); ... } catch { /* a new file */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (history.ndjson not created yet), log the rest; no fallback value, `lead` stays `''`.

### tools/lessons-publish.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/lessons-publish.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 204 `if (created) await fs.unlink(target).catch(() => {});`: cleanup catch in an error path that rethrows the original error (`throw io('file')` on the next line) — LOG-ALWAYS with a different binding, include the target path; no fallback value, best-effort unlink.
- Line 206 `} finally { if (handle) await handle.close().catch(() => {}); }`: close/cleanup catch reached on every exit of a function whose catch path rethrows — LOG-ALWAYS with a different binding; no fallback value, best-effort close.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
